description: This source file contains test cases for the transformation functions related to Vertex AI Gemini models within the litellm project. The tests focus on verifying request body transformations, including handling of optional labels, metadata, and image configuration parameters for different Gemini model variants.

methods.name: test__transform_request_body_labels()
methods.description: Tests that the request body correctly includes 'labels' parameters for Vertex AI requests.

methods.name: test__transform_request_body_metadata()
methods.description: Verifies that 'metadata' parameters are used when 'labels' are not provided.

methods.name: test__transform_request_body_labels_and_metadata()
methods.description: Ensures that if 'labels' are supplied, 'metadata' parameters are ignored.

methods.name: test__transform_request_body_image_config()
methods.description: Checks support for 'imageConfig' parameter for Gemini model 'gemini-2.5-flash-image'.

methods.name: test__transform_request_body_image_config_snake_case()
methods.description: Tests support for snake_case 'image_config' parameter, ensuring proper transformation to 'imageConfig'.

methods.name: test__transform_request_body_image_config_with_image_size()
methods.description: Verifies handling of 'imageSize' parameter within 'imageConfig', e.g., for generating high-resolution images.
